submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 8 (Ca0.22 Fe0.66 Mn0.12) gave the highest photocurrent (1e-8 A) under 2.72 eV illumination. The Fe-rich/low-Ca point (idx 0) gave ~0, and the Ca-rich brownmillerite-like point (idx 46) gave a negative photocurrent. XRD on idx 13, 14 and 104 showed the same dominant fcc-type pattern (Q≈2.79, 3.21, 4.56, 5.34) everywhere, which may come from the substrate or a common phase. It did not separate the composition regions.

rejected.reason: Ca-rich (Ca~0.5, Fe~0.35): measured -7e-8 A, which is cathodic or no photoanodic response
Mn oxides are generally poor photoanodes. XRD of idx 13 showed extra low-Q peaks from a secondary phase. Not measured because of the budget
